Designed for developers

Your app, your rules,
your API.

Register once, then manage everything through a focused dashboard or the REST API. No platform-specific runtime. No vendor lock-in.

RESTPythonJavaScript.NETJavaC++
activate.py
from license_platform_sdk import LicenseClient

client = LicenseClient(
    base_url="https://api.your-domain.com",
    app_id="your-application",
    storage_path="license-token.json"
)

client.activate(customer_license_key)
client.validate_online()
